result.summary: The intersection is controlled by vehicle traffic signals but completely lacks pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or dedicated pedestrian signals. This creates a high-risk environment where pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without designated space or clear right-of-way indicators.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection fails to define a safe path for pedestrians and may lead to driver confusion regarding right-of-way.

hazards.description: Pedestrians have no dedicated signal phase or countdown, forcing them to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate crossing time.
